### 📍 Location Details

### 🚫 Barrier Description
A clear and concise description of the physical or digital accessibility barrier encountered.

### ⚖️ Barrier Severity Tier
- [ ] **Tier 1 - Critical:** Complete blockade preventing access (e.g. no ramp, missing elevator to upper floors)
- [ ] **Tier 2 - High:** Severe difficulty or safety hazard (e.g. ramp gradient > 1:10, inward-opening toilet door)
- [ ] **Tier 3 - Medium:** Partial barrier causing inconvenience (e.g. missing tactile ground indicators, high door handle)
- [ ] **Tier 4 - Low:** Minor maintenance deficit (e.g. faded signage, glare on display)
